lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Hold onto your dentures, [beat] because we’re jumping over the neighbor’s hedge at sixty miles per hour!

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: Nani, [beat] I thought you were just taking us to get ice cream, not auditioning for a high-speed chase!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Rafiq, [beat] look at the GPS tracking! My mother is currently airborne over the expressway on a custom Vespa!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I knew that arthritis was just a cover-up [beat] for the adrenaline addiction she's been hiding since the eighties!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Look at that billboard [beat] downtown! That’s Nani in a leather suit, [beat] and it says ‘The Ghost Rider of Dhaka’!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: The stunt community doesn't care about your age, [beat] they only care if you can nail a triple backflip on a scooter!

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: We just landed in the middle of a red carpet, [beat] and everyone is throwing roses at our dirty tires!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I spent millions on my car collection, [beat] yet Nani is the one getting the Lifetime Achievement Award for bravery!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: All those times you said you were going to the pharmacy, [beat] you were actually jumping through rings of fire!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Medicine is expensive, [beat] but movie studios pay a premium for a grandma who doesn't know the meaning of fear.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: And here I was [beat] trying to help you cross the street yesterday while you were planning a rooftop jump!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Don't be sad, Rafiq. [beat] I’ve used my secret stunt checks to pay off your mortgage, [beat] so keep your mouth shut!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The family finally realized Nani wasn't fragile; [beat] she was actually the most dangerous woman in the film industry.

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: Can we go again, Nani? [beat] I want to see if we can clear the principal's house on the way back home tonight!
